intended_object: The functor from R-algebras to monoid objects in the monoidal category of R-modules, for a commutative ring R. An algebra goes to its underlying module, with unit the algebra map and multiplication induced on the tensor product; an algebra map goes to its underlying linear map. It is the inverse half of the equivalence Mon(R-Mod) ≃ R-Alg. Inferred from the docstring, the name and the namespace.
explanation: Objects: each algebra A is sent to its underlying module ↧A with the monoid structure inverseObj A. Morphisms: an algebra map f is sent to f.toLinearMap. Compatibility with the unit is checked by f.commutes and compatibility with multiplication by map_mul. This is exactly the standard functor R-Alg → Mon(R-Mod). A commutative ring R is the natural setting for this equivalence. The definition is part of Mathlib, so there is no separate counterpart to cite.
